title: The Two BEST Investments *NOW* in THIS Economy.
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.theme: Yields driven by oil, not fiscal crisis
macro_themes.view: Bond-yield spike is largely oil/Middle East driven with a growing economy; an Iran deal would likely mark peak yields.
Warsh and his task forces oppose QE and favour balance-sheet shrinkage and even negative rates, so the next crisis will not be met with money printing.
Expects a recession/crash within the next decade (guess by 2032) once the AI party ends (labor market, data-center financing are the canaries); market rates then plunge to record lows.
Hold little debt, buy held-to-maturity Treasuries (2y ~4.94%), and buy below-market real estate in supply-constrained areas like coastal SoCal; keep some stock exposure for now.

calls.condition: Peak yields likely if an Iran deal comes; timing of the bond rally depends on the next crisis
calls.reason: Yields at peak-ish levels on oil; without Fed money printing, a future crisis sends buyers into Treasuries and the 10y to record lows; bonds held to maturity are the best decade investment.
calls.quote: the more the 10-year yield actually goes down to levels that eventually end up even lower than we've ever seen before

calls.reason: Warsh runs an anti-gold Fed; gold peaked when Warsh was chosen; bonds beat gold once the oil-driven inflation passes.
calls.quote: This is literally the anti- gold Fed... bonds are probably the big winners here over gold

calls.reason: Buying the dip because an Iran deal is coming and the AI bubble is not over (10 pm at the party), but expects a bust within a decade.
